definitions.explanation: A building that houses a government agency or administrative office, such as a city hall, prefectural office, or national ministry building.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{庁舎|ちょうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{完成|かんせい}した→完成する：25528_kanseisuru⟧。
examples.english: The new government building was completed.

examples.japanese: {市|し}{庁舎|ちょうしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The city hall building is in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{庁舎|ちょうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: The government building suffered major damage in the earthquake.

notes:
A compound of {庁|ちょう} (government office, agency) + {舎|しゃ} (building, quarters). Refers specifically to buildings that house government administrative functions, not private office buildings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {市|し}{庁舎|ちょうしゃ}: city hall building
- ⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧{庁舎|ちょうしゃ}: prefectural office building
- {庁舎|ちょうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建|た}て{替|か}え→建て替え：19739_tatekae⟧: rebuilding of a government office
- ⟦{仮|かり}→仮：11551_kari⟧{庁舎|ちょうしゃ}: temporary government building

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{役所|やくしょ}→役所：06455_yakusho⟧: government office — refers to the institution or office itself, while {庁舎|ちょうしゃ} emphasizes the physical building
- ⟦{市役所|しやくしょ}→市役所：03067_shiyakusho⟧: city hall — the office as an institution, whereas {市|し}{庁舎|ちょうしゃ} refers to the building housing it
- ⟦{官庁|かんちょう}→官庁：12470_kanchou⟧: government agency — refers to the organization rather than the building
